# Subash Saajan J

> Full-stack engineer based in Tamil Nadu, India, working remotely in TypeScript, Go and Python. Sees each feature through from start to finish, from the database and APIs to the screens people use and the servers they run on.

Also known as: Subash Saajan. GitHub: Subash-Saajan.

## Work

- Software Engineer at Sentellent (Feb 2026 to present, remote), an AI learning platform for teachers and students. Designed the platform's key selling features: a complete AI grading system, where teachers review every grade before release, and an AI assistant that can handle tasks across the platform, rebuilt as a multi-step LangGraph agent with long-term memory and tools limited to each user's role. Built the hybrid RAG behind it (vector plus keyword search over each course's own material) and an evaluation harness that scores simulated conversations with an LLM judge. Ships across the whole product: PostgreSQL, Python backend APIs, the React/TypeScript app, and AWS.

## Projects

- [PrintEz](https://printez.app): a printing platform. Customers scan a QR code, upload a document, pay by UPI and collect the print at a self-service kiosk or a partner print shop. Go (Fiber) backend with PostgreSQL, Redis and Cloudflare R2, a Next.js customer site, and device software in Go (a Raspberry Pi kiosk agent and a Windows app for shops). Print jobs are crash-safe and device updates are signed.
- [DR20 HomeCare](https://www.dr20.in): lead engineer on a healthcare booking app for a charitable trust. TypeScript monorepo with a React Native (Expo) Android app, a NestJS backend on PostgreSQL, a React admin console and a Next.js website, hosted on Google Cloud.
- [Cortex](https://github.com/Subash-Saajan/cortex_agent): an AI email and calendar assistant on LangGraph and Gemini. Drafts emails and calendar events that the user confirms before anything is sent. Long-term memory on PostgreSQL with pgvector, Gmail and Calendar through Google OAuth. Was deployed on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS) with Docker, Terraform and GitHub Actions.
- [Vadavai Matha](https://vadavai-matha.vercel.app): bilingual (English and Tamil) website for the Holy Family Shrine in Vadakkankulam, built with Next.js and TypeScript, with structured data and cited history pages.
- [ClipSmith](https://github.com/Subash-Saajan/ClipSmith): turns long YouTube videos into short clips using speech-to-text and an LLM, with a NestJS and BullMQ job queue.
- Other sites: [Fenivi Research](https://feniviresearch.in), [GBS Accelerate](https://gbsaccelerate.com), [Anfed](https://anfed.vercel.app), [Brighty Beauty](https://brightybeauty.com).

- Languages: TypeScript, Go, Python, SQL

- AI: LLM agents (LangGraph), OpenAI, Gemini, RAG, AI evaluation
